scope_note: Offline, read-only diagnostic. Appearance-association calibration (H5) is out of scope. Structural classification (H3) is keyword-based over free-text labels and reported as a sensitivity result.

degree_comparison.note: canonical_* counts distinct supported neighbors on the undirected graph; incidence_* counts supported relation records touching each entity over ALL records (derived twins included) and is inflated relative to the true node degree.

h2_candidate_density.note: canonical_pair_predicate_candidates counts (pair, predicate) evaluations (49284); unique_evaluated_pairs collapses predicates to unordered entity pairs. The two differ because next_to and touching can both be candidates for the same pair.

h3_structural_multiplier.caveat: There is no structural-surface type in the domain. These flags come from whole-word keyword matches over free-text hypothesis labels and are a sensitivity estimate, not ground truth.

h4_graph_materialization.note: Context map materializes every relation record, including derived twins and rejected/unresolved evaluations; 'supported' here is the doubled figure (2x the canonical supported edge count).
